inputs: docs/UI_REFERENCE/data/uiprobe.json (NOT YET HARVESTED - runtime colours, font metrics, standard button frames)
docs/VISUAL_STYLE_GUIDE.md (MavLinOS visual decisions where the guest has not been measured)
generated_from.generator: hand-authored for the specification example; will be tools/uiplatform/tokens.py

color.window.background.notes: Decoded from AppKit's __color ramp as the most frequent solid white in content contexts (palette fact appkit.color.ffffff.aff).

color.control.background.top.notes: AppKit __color ramp top of aqua.control.solid; exact role mapping still open (see gap on component.button.push).

color.control.background.bottom.notes: Palette fact appkit.color.dddddd.add: 1199 occurrences in the __color ramp with a=0.867.

color.selection.control.notes: Muted Mavericks blue; the graphite variant is our substitution for the Graphite accent, not a measured value.

color.traffic.close.top.notes: Placeholder until uiprobe reports the real pixel.

linux_substitute.reason: Lucida Grande is licensed Apple artwork and is NOT redistributed (UI_REFERENCE rule C5).

font.system.size.notes: docs/VISUAL_STYLE_GUIDE.md target; uiprobe text.fonts would confirm the real system font size and metrics.

font.system.metrics.notes: Zeroes are deliberate placeholders. mvprobe.c already prints exactly these five numbers per font role; fill them from docs/UI_REFERENCE/data/uiprobe.json.

metric.menubar.height.notes: MavLinOS visual decision from docs/VISUAL_STYLE_GUIDE.md; the guest value must still be read from the real menu bar.

metric.window.chrome.height.notes: 22 pt is a placeholder. Derivation for the real value: uiprobe window.contentRectMath compares the requested frame height with contentRectForFrameRect:styleMask:7; the difference is the chrome height. That output was never harvested.

easing.standard.notes: CSS-like default ease; replace with the curve AppKit actually uses for standard view animations.

shadow.window.rest.notes: Restrained Mavericks shadow; a capture of a real window over wallpaper is needed to confirm the radius.
